notes.title: Oversight 0.40.0
notes.content:
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]Adds assassination mechanic.
[*]Adds commission mechanic.
[*]Replaces infiltration with wiretap.
    - Created on sector nodes (2AP).
    - Moved once per turn for free.
    - Destroyed by background checks.
    - Reveals all passing messages (without the ability to disrupt).
[*]Adds fog of war mechanic.
[*]Changes recruit to occur mid-connection.
[*]Reverses the direction of travel of intel.
[*]Removes automatic loyalty from director.
[*]Changes intercepted messages to show the agent they are coming from and traveling to (instead of the full path after the point of interception).
[*]Changes intercepted messages to no longer show the sector they are traveling to/from on the icon.
[*]Changes wiretap cost to 2AP.
[*]Changes paying enemy agent cost to 2AP.
[*]Changes cost of add loyalty to 2AP.
[*]Allows background check on own director.
[/list]

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Revises tutorial to make it clearer.
[*]Adds section to tutorial to expalin re-routing a message.
[*]Autohides alerts a short time after a new turn starts.
[*]Increases the speed of the action button animation.
[*]Adds animations to the start-of-turn sequence.
[*]Adds animation to the pending action list.
[*]Adds link to Discord server to the main menu menu screen.
[*]Adds button to the main menu screen to show this popup.
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixes "reduce loyalty" showing as "increase loyalty" in the pending action list.
[*]Fixes disrupted messages not showing their path on hover.
[/list]

notes.title: Oversight 0.39.0
notes.content:
[h1]New Features and Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] "What's new?" pop-up to inform players of changes added.
[*] Sound effects added: operation complete, new operation, begin turn, and undo.
[*] Patch designator added to game version.
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Different client versions were not prevented from joining the same game.
[*] Message pulses were not repeating.
[*] All music tracks would play simultaneously during local multiplayer.
[*] Defeat music track would play after victory.
[*] Review game after ending local multiplayer game was not functional.
[/list]

notes.title: Oversight 0.38
notes.content:
[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Tutorial would not return to the main menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Oversight 0.37
notes.content:
[h1]New Features and Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Settings menu with volume controls has been added.
[*] Loops in message paths are now prevented.
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Button image was misaligned during hover.
[*] Clicks below round indicator were being blocked.
[/list]

notes.title: Oversight 0.36
notes.content:
[h1]New Features and Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] It is no longer allowed to connect the director to a sector agent directly.
[*] Right-click now cancels/deselects.
[*] Skip button removed from new turn alerts (Next button remains).
[*] New art added to menu screen.
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Intel wasn't refunded on undo (visual only).
[*] New agents would sometimes not have action buttons.
[*] Connections would sometimes show as highlighted a the wrong time.
[*] The next round would sometimes flash before the new turn notifications appeared.
[/list]

notes.title: Post-launch hotfixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the game from leaving the setup phase. (aka the "Big Bad Bug")
[*] Fixed a bug that made the game un-winnable when objectives were completed by both players.
[*] Fixed several typos in the tutorial.
[*] Fixed inconsistent terminology.
[/list]
